## Surplus Items

- 6A.6 (a) The Contractorshall notuse theFree IssueItemsfor anypurpose other than the carrying out and completion of the Works.
- (b) AnysurplusFreeIssueItemsshailbereturnedingoodconditionby the Contractor to the Employerto astorage area to be notified to the ContractorbytheProjectManager.

## RemovalfromSite

6A.7The Contractor shall not remove any of the Free Issue Items from the Site.

## 7. BONDS

## ProvisionofBonds

- 7.1 TheContractorundertakes toobtainand delivertotheProjectManager within fourteen (14) days after the Commencement Date for approval by the Employer:
- (a) aPerformanceBond,intheformattached totheseConditionsof Contract as AppendixB(the"Performance Bond"),which shallbe purpose. Such Bond shall be in the amount stated in the Particular Conditions; and
- (b) anAdvancePaymentBondintheformattachedtotheseConditions of Contract as Appendix C (the "Advance Payment Bond") which shall be issued by a bank in the Country approved by the Employer for the purpose. Such Bond shall be in the amount equal to the AdvancePaymcnt.

## CostofProvidingBonds

- 7.2 All costs of obtaining and keeping in force the Performance Bond and the AdvancePaymentBondshall beborneandpaidbytheContractor.

## ApportionmentofPerformanceBond

- 7.3 An appropriate proportion of the Performance Bond as determined from timetotimebytheProjectManagerafterreferencetotheBillsofQuantities and thevaluationof theWorksunderClause25.2(WorkstobeMeasured) shall applytoeachSection andPortion of theWorks.Suchproportion as delerminedbytheProjectManagershallbenotified inwritingbythcProjcct Managerto theEmployerand theContractor.

## ReductionofAdvancePaymentBond

- 7.4 Thevalueof theAdvancePaymentBondshall bereducedbythe amountof the Advance Payment recovered under Clause 26.2 (lssue of Interim Certificates).
